name: plugin.ui_behavior_primitive_architect
description: UI Behavior Primitive Architect plugin providing definePrimitive auditing, WebMCP agent bridge safety checks, WAI-ARIA/SSR/RTL tri-modal verification, and framework expert scope routing
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: ui_audit_primitive
entrypoints.description: Audit a headless definePrimitive contract for naming, render-prop, controlled/default collisions, live overlap, and agent action binding

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Primitive kebab-case name

parameters.name: state_keys
parameters.description: State keys defined on the primitive

parameters.name: live_keys
parameters.description: Non-rendering live keys

parameters.name: controlled_keys
parameters.description: Explicit controlled state keys

parameters.name: provided_options
parameters.description: Initial options passed to the primitive

parameters.name: api_methods
parameters.description: Methods exposed on instance.api

parameters.name: agent_actions
parameters.description: Actions declared in primitive agent.actions

parameters.name: has_asleep_predicate
parameters.description: Whether asleep lazy wake-up predicate is configured

parameters.name: has_render_as_prop
parameters.description: Whether an invalid as prop is used instead of render

entrypoints.name: ui_evaluate_agent_step
entrypoints.description: Evaluate a WebMCP / page agent bridge step against DOM marks (hidden/secret/confirm) and action synonyms

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Stable component reference

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component kind

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Requested action or synonym

parameters.name: available_actions
parameters.description: Live actions exposed by the component

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Current or target component value

parameters.name: confirm_attr
parameters.description: Optional data-agent-confirm prompt

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: Whether inside data-agent-hidden

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Whether inside data-agent-secret or sensitive field

parameters.name: person_approved
parameters.description: Explicit human approval result for confirm steps

parameters.name: tool_name
parameters.description: WebMCP tool name (snapshot, act, or query)

entrypoints.name: ui_verify_tri_modal
entrypoints.description: Aggregate WAI-ARIA APG pattern checks, SSR clock/DOM isolation findings, and mirrored LTR vs RTL parity checks

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: WAI-ARIA APG pattern name

parameters.name: aria_violations
parameters.description: Observed ARIA or keyboard focus defects

parameters.name: ssr_globals_accessed
parameters.description: Browser/clock/entropy globals accessed during server render

parameters.name: ltr_focus
parameters.description: Focused target after ArrowRight in LTR

parameters.name: rtl_focus
parameters.description: Focused target after ArrowLeft in RTL

parameters.name: ltr_state
parameters.description: Normalized state object from LTR mount

parameters.name: rtl_state
parameters.description: Normalized state object from RTL mount

entrypoints.name: ui_plan_expert_scope
entrypoints.description: Compute triggered framework experts (react, vue, svelte, solid, web) from changed repository file paths

parameters.name: changed_files
parameters.description: List of changed workspace-relative file paths
